questions.scenario: The diagram shows a food web in a savanna. The arrows show the direction in which energy flows.
questions.scenarioAf: Die diagram toon ’n voedselweb in ’n savanne. Die pyltjies toon die rigting waarin energie vloei.

questions.q: Define a community.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n gemeenskap.
points: All the populations of different species
living and interacting in the same area at the same time
pointsAf: Al die bevolkings van verskillende spesies
wat op dieselfde tyd in dieselfde gebied leef en in wisselwerking is

questions.q: Name the TWO producers in the food web.
questions.qAf: Noem die TWEE produsente in die voedselweb.
points: grass and acacia
pointsAf: gras en akasia

questions.q: Name ONE herbivore in the food web.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN herbivoor in die voedselweb.
points: grasshopper, impala or giraffe
pointsAf: sprinkaan, rooibok of kameelperd

questions.q: Write down a food chain from the web that has FOUR organisms.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n voedselketting uit die web neer wat VIER organismes het.
points: grass → grasshopper → lizard → eagle
pointsAf: gras → sprinkaan → akkedis → arend

questions.q: Give the trophic level of the eagle in your food chain.
questions.qAf: Gee die trofiese vlak van die arend in jou voedselketting.
points: tertiary consumer (fourth trophic level)
pointsAf: tersiêre verbruiker (vierde trofiese vlak)

questions.q: Predict what will happen to the number of lions if all the cheetahs are removed. Explain.
questions.qAf: Voorspel wat met die aantal leeus sal gebeur as al die jagluiperds verwyder word. Verduidelik.
points: The number of lions will increase
because more impala will be available for the lions to eat
pointsAf: Die aantal leeus sal toeneem
omdat meer rooibokke vir die leeus beskikbaar sal wees om te eet

questions.q: The acacia trees hold 20 000 kJ of energy. Calculate how much of this energy can reach the lions through the giraffes.
questions.qAf: Die akasiabome bevat 20 000 kJ energie. Bereken hoeveel van hierdie energie die leeus deur die kameelperde kan bereik.
points: giraffes: 10% of 20 000 = 2 000 kJ
lions: 10% of 2 000 = 200 kJ
pointsAf: kameelperde: 10% van 20 000 = 2 000 kJ
leeus: 10% van 2 000 = 200 kJ

questions.q: Explain why a pyramid of energy is always wider at the bottom.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n energiepiramide altyd onder wyer is.
points: Energy is lost at each trophic level, mostly as heat through respiration
so each level has less energy than the level below it
pointsAf: Energie gaan by elke trofiese vlak verlore, meestal as hitte deur respirasie
dus het elke vlak minder energie as die vlak daaronder

questions.q: Name ONE abiotic factor that affects the organisms in a savanna.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN abiotiese faktor wat die organismes in ’n savanne beïnvloed.
points: rainfall, temperature, sunlight, soil or fire
pointsAf: reënval, temperatuur, sonlig, grond of vuur

sections.title: Support and transport systems in animals

questions.q: Tabulate TWO differences between an exoskeleton and an endoskeleton.
questions.qAf: Tabuleer TWEE verskille tussen ’n eksoskelet en ’n endoskelet.
points: Exoskeleton: on the outside of the body / Endoskeleton: inside the body
Exoskeleton: non-living, so the animal must moult to grow / Endoskeleton: living tissue that grows with the animal
pointsAf: Eksoskelet: aan die buitekant van die liggaam / Endoskelet: binne die liggaam
Eksoskelet: nielewend, dus moet die dier vervel om te groei / Endoskelet: lewende weefsel wat saam met die dier groei

questions.q: Name THREE parts of the axial skeleton.
questions.qAf: Noem DRIE dele van die aksiale skelet.
points: skull
vertebral column
ribs or sternum
pointsAf: skedel
werwelkolom
ribbes of borsbeen

questions.q: Name the type of joint at the knee and describe the movement it allows.
questions.qAf: Noem die soort gewrig by die knie en beskryf die beweging wat dit toelaat.
points: hinge joint
movement in one plane only (bending and straightening)
pointsAf: skarniergewrig
beweging in slegs een vlak (buig en strek)

questions.q: Describe arthritis and give ONE cause.
questions.qAf: Beskryf artritis en gee EEN oorsaak.
points: Painful inflammation of the joints, often with damaged cartilage
ageing and wear, injury, or the immune system attacking the joints
pointsAf: Pynlike ontsteking van die gewrigte, dikwels met beskadigde kraakbeen
veroudering en slytasie, besering, of die immuunstelsel wat die gewrigte aanval

questions.q: Explain how the arm is straightened at the elbow.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe die arm by die elmboog gestrek word.
points: The triceps contracts
while the biceps relaxes
pointsAf: Die triseps trek saam
terwyl die biseps ontspan

questions.q: Name the tissue inside some bones that makes blood cells.
questions.qAf: Noem die weefsel binne sommige bene wat bloedselle maak.
points: red bone marrow
pointsAf: rooi beenmurg

questions.q: Name the valve between the left atrium and the left ventricle.
questions.qAf: Noem die klep tussen die linkeratrium en die linkerventrikel.
points: bicuspid (mitral) valve
pointsAf: bikuspidale (mitrale) klep

questions.q: State the function of the semilunar valves.
questions.qAf: Noem die funksie van die halfmaankleppe.
points: They prevent blood from flowing back
from the arteries into the ventricles
pointsAf: Hulle verhoed dat bloed terugvloei
van die slagare na die ventrikels

questions.q: Name the blood vessel that carries blood away from the left ventricle.
questions.qAf: Noem die bloedvat wat bloed weg van die linkerventrikel vervoer.
points: aorta
pointsAf: aorta

questions.q: Distinguish between systole and diastole.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen sistole en diastole.
points: Systole: the heart muscle contracts
Diastole: the heart muscle relaxes and the chambers fill with blood
pointsAf: Sistole: die hartspier trek saam
Diastole: die hartspier ontspan en die kamers vul met bloed

questions.q: Tabulate THREE differences between veins and capillaries.
questions.qAf: Tabuleer DRIE verskille tussen are en kapillêre.
points: Veins: walls with muscle and connective tissue / Capillaries: walls only one cell thick
Veins: have valves / Capillaries: no valves
Veins: wide lumen / Capillaries: very narrow lumen
pointsAf: Are: wande met spier en bindweefsel / Kapillêre: wande slegs een sel dik
Are: het kleppe / Kapillêre: geen kleppe nie
Are: wye lumen / Kapillêre: baie nou lumen

questions.q: State TWO functions of the lymphatic system.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE funksies van die limfstelsel.
points: It returns tissue fluid to the blood
the lymph nodes help to fight infection
pointsAf: Dit gee weefselvloeistof terug aan die bloed
die limfknope help om infeksie te beveg

questions.scenario: The table shows the average systolic blood pressure of people of different ages.
questions.scenarioAf: Die tabel toon die gemiddelde sistoliese bloeddruk van mense van verskillende ouderdomme.

questions.q: Describe the trend shown in the table.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die neiging wat in die tabel getoon word.
points: As age increases
the average systolic blood pressure increases
pointsAf: Soos ouderdom toeneem
neem die gemiddelde sistoliese bloeddruk toe

questions.q: Calculate the increase in blood pressure from age 20 to age 80.
questions.qAf: Bereken die toename in bloeddruk van ouderdom 20 tot ouderdom 80.

questions.q: Suggest ONE reason why blood pressure increases with age.
questions.qAf: Stel EEN rede voor waarom bloeddruk met ouderdom toeneem.
points: The artery walls lose their elasticity, or fatty deposits narrow the arteries
so the heart must pump harder to push blood through them
pointsAf: Die slagaarwande verloor hul elastisiteit, of vetneerslae vernou die slagare
dus moet die hart harder pomp om bloed daardeur te stoot

questions.q: Give the term for blood pressure that is permanently too high.
questions.qAf: Gee die term vir bloeddruk wat permanent te hoog is.
points: hypertension
pointsAf: hipertensie

questions.q: Give TWO lifestyle changes that can lower blood pressure.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE leefstylveranderinge wat bloeddruk kan verlaag.
points: regular exercise
eating less salt and fat, losing weight, or not smoking
pointsAf: gereelde oefening
minder sout en vet eet, gewig verloor, of nie rook nie

questions.q: Name the instrument used to measure blood pressure.
questions.qAf: Noem die instrument wat gebruik word om bloeddruk te meet.
points: sphygmomanometer
pointsAf: sfigmomanometer

questions.q: State TWO functions of blood plasma.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE funksies van bloedplasma.
points: It transports dissolved substances such as glucose, carbon dioxide and hormones
it distributes heat through the body
pointsAf: Dit vervoer opgeloste stowwe soos glukose, koolstofdioksied en hormone
dit versprei hitte deur die liggaam

questions.q: Give ONE way in which a red blood cell is adapted to carry oxygen.
questions.qAf: Gee EEN manier waarop ’n rooibloedsel aangepas is om suurstof te vervoer.
points: It has no nucleus, leaving more room for haemoglobin, or it is biconcave for a large surface area
pointsAf: Dit het geen kern nie, wat meer ruimte vir hemoglobien laat, of dit is bikonkaaf vir ’n groot oppervlakte

sections.title: Ecosystems, biodiversity and the history of life
sections.titleAf: Ekosisteme, biodiversiteit en die geskiedenis van lewe

questions.q: Distinguish between a habitat and a niche.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen ’n habitat en ’n nis.
points: A habitat is the place where an organism lives
a niche is the role of an organism in its ecosystem
pointsAf: ’n Habitat is die plek waar ’n organisme leef
’n nis is die rol van ’n organisme in sy ekosisteem

questions.q: Describe how nitrogen from the air becomes available to plants.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe stikstof uit die lug vir plante beskikbaar word.
points: Nitrogen-fixing bacteria, e.g. in the root nodules of legumes
change nitrogen gas into ammonium compounds and nitrates
lightning also changes nitrogen into nitrates
plants absorb the nitrates from the soil through their roots
pointsAf: Stikstofbindende bakterieë, bv. in die wortelknoppies van peulplante
verander stikstofgas in ammoniumverbindings en nitrate
weerlig verander ook stikstof in nitrate
plante absorbeer die nitrate deur hul wortels uit die grond

questions.q: Describe TWO characteristics of the savanna biome.
questions.qAf: Beskryf TWEE kenmerke van die savannebioom.
points: Summer rainfall with a dry winter
grassland with scattered trees
pointsAf: Somerreën met ’n droë winter
grasveld met verspreide bome

questions.q: Explain how a pyramid of numbers can be upside down.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe ’n getallepiramide onderstebo kan wees.
points: When the producer is a single large organism, such as a tree
which supports many small consumers, such as insects
pointsAf: Wanneer die produsent ’n enkele groot organisme is, soos ’n boom
wat baie klein verbruikers, soos insekte, onderhou

questions.q: Give TWO reasons why biomes should be conserved.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE redes waarom biome bewaar moet word.
points: to protect biodiversity
for ecosystem services such as clean water and soil, or for tourism
pointsAf: om biodiversiteit te beskerm
vir ekosisteemdienste soos skoon water en grond, of vir toerisme

questions.q: Give TWO reasons why scientists classify organisms.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE redes waarom wetenskaplikes organismes klassifiseer.
points: to organise the huge variety of organisms
to show how organisms are related, and so that scientists everywhere use the same names
pointsAf: om die groot verskeidenheid organismes te orden
om te toon hoe organismes verwant is, en sodat wetenskaplikes oral dieselfde name gebruik

questions.scenario: The scientific name of the cheetah is Acinonyx jubatus.
questions.scenarioAf: Die wetenskaplike naam van die jagluiperd is Acinonyx jubatus.

questions.q: Name the genus of the cheetah.
questions.qAf: Noem die genus van die jagluiperd.
points: Acinonyx
pointsAf: Acinonyx

questions.q: Write down the species name of the cheetah.
questions.qAf: Skryf die spesienaam van die jagluiperd neer.
points: jubatus
pointsAf: jubatus

questions.q: Explain why scientific names are more useful than common names.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom wetenskaplike name nuttiger as gewone name is.
points: A scientific name is the same in all languages
while common names differ from place to place and can cause confusion
pointsAf: ’n Wetenskaplike naam is dieselfde in alle tale
terwyl gewone name van plek tot plek verskil en verwarring kan veroorsaak

questions.q:
Use the key to identify plants P to S.
P: produces seeds inside fruits from flowers
Q: produces seeds in cones
R: has fronds and vascular tissue, but no seeds
S: small, with no vascular tissue and no seeds
Key:
1a Produces seeds … go to 2
1b No seeds … go to 3
2a Has flowers … angiosperm
2b Has cones … gymnosperm
3a Vascular tissue present … fern
3b No vascular tissue … moss
questions.qAf:
Gebruik die sleutel om plante P tot S te identifiseer.
P: produseer sade binne vrugte uit blomme
Q: produseer sade in keëls
R: het varingblare en vaatweefsel, maar geen sade nie
S: klein, met geen vaatweefsel en geen sade nie
Sleutel:
1a Produseer sade … gaan na 2
1b Geen sade nie … gaan na 3
2a Het blomme … angiosperm
2b Het keëls … gimnosperm
3a Vaatweefsel teenwoordig … varing
3b Geen vaatweefsel nie … mos
points: P: angiosperm
Q: gymnosperm
R: fern
S: moss
pointsAf: P: angiosperm
Q: gimnosperm
R: varing
S: mos

questions.q: Distinguish between prokaryotes and eukaryotes.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen prokariote en eukariote.
points: Prokaryotes have no nucleus or membrane-bound organelles
eukaryotes have a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles
pointsAf: Prokariote het geen kern of membraangebonde organelle nie
eukariote het ’n kern en membraangebonde organelle

questions.q: Name the floral kingdom in South Africa that has the highest number of plant species for its size, and give ONE threat to it.
questions.qAf: Noem die blommeryk in Suid-Afrika wat die meeste plantspesies vir sy grootte het, en gee EEN bedreiging daarvoor.
points: the Cape Floral Kingdom
alien invasive plants, urban development, or fires that are too frequent
pointsAf: die Kaapse Blommeryk
uitheemse indringerplante, stedelike ontwikkeling, of vure wat te gereeld is

questions.q: Name, from oldest to youngest, the THREE eras that followed the Precambrian.
questions.qAf: Noem, van oudste tot jongste, die DRIE eras wat op die Prekambrium gevolg het.
points: Palaeozoic
Mesozoic
Cenozoic
pointsAf: Paleosoïkum
Mesosoïkum
Senosoïkum

questions.q: What is a mass extinction?
questions.qAf: Wat is ’n massa-uitsterwing?
points: The dying out of a large number of species
in a relatively short period of geological time
pointsAf: Die uitsterwing van ’n groot aantal spesies
in ’n relatief kort tydperk van geologiese tyd

questions.q: What are trace fossils? Give an example.
questions.qAf: Wat is spoorfossiele? Gee ’n voorbeeld.
points: Fossils that show the activity of an organism rather than its body
e.g. footprints, burrows or droppings
pointsAf: Fossiele wat die aktiwiteit van ’n organisme toon eerder as sy liggaam
bv. voetspore, gange of mis

questions.q: Potassium-40 has a half-life of 1,25 billion years. A rock contains 12,5% of its original potassium-40. Calculate the age of the rock.
questions.qAf: Kalium-40 het ’n halfleeftyd van 1,25 miljard jaar. ’n Rots bevat 12,5% van sy oorspronklike kalium-40. Bereken die ouderdom van die rots.
points: 100% → 50% → 25% → 12,5% is three half-lives
3 × 1,25 = 3,75 billion years
pointsAf: 100% → 50% → 25% → 12,5% is drie halfleeftye
3 × 1,25 = 3,75 miljard jaar

questions.q: Explain why fossils are rare.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom fossiele skaars is.
points: Special conditions are needed, such as quick burial where there is little oxygen
most organisms decay or are eaten before they can be fossilised
pointsAf: Spesiale toestande is nodig, soos vinnige begrawing waar daar min suurstof is
die meeste organismes ontbind of word opgeëet voordat hulle gefossiliseer kan word

questions.q: Name the South African region famous for fossils of dinosaurs and mammal-like reptiles.
questions.qAf: Noem die Suid-Afrikaanse streek wat bekend is vir fossiele van dinosourusse en soogdieragtige reptiele.
points: the Karoo
pointsAf: die Karoo

questions.q: Explain why the Cambrian period is important in the history of life.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die Kambriese tydperk belangrik is in die geskiedenis van lewe.
points: Most of the major animal groups appeared during this period
and many had hard parts, so they left many fossils
pointsAf: Die meeste van die hoofgroepe diere het gedurende hierdie tydperk verskyn
en baie het harde dele gehad, dus het hulle baie fossiele gelaat

questions.q:
Describe the structure of a synovial joint, explain how muscles and bones work together to move the arm, and describe arthritis and osteoporosis.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf die struktuur van ’n sinoviale gewrig, verduidelik hoe spiere en bene saamwerk om die arm te beweeg, en beskryf artritis en osteoporose.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points: The ends of the bones are covered with cartilage
which reduces friction and absorbs shock
The synovial membrane secretes synovial fluid
which lubricates the joint
Ligaments hold the bones of the joint together
A tough capsule surrounds the joint
Muscles are attached to bones by tendons
Muscles can only pull when they contract
so they work in antagonistic pairs
To bend the arm the biceps contracts
and the triceps relaxes
To straighten the arm the triceps contracts and the biceps relaxes
The bones act as levers and the joint as the pivot
Arthritis is a painful inflammation of the joints
in which the cartilage wears away
Osteoporosis makes the bones lose calcium and become brittle
It can be prevented by a diet with enough calcium and vitamin D, and by exercise
pointsAf: Die punte van die bene is met kraakbeen bedek
wat wrywing verminder en skokke absorbeer
Die sinoviale membraan skei sinoviale vloeistof af
wat die gewrig smeer
Ligamente hou die bene van die gewrig bymekaar
’n Taai kapsel omring die gewrig
Spiere is deur senings aan bene geheg
Spiere kan slegs trek wanneer hulle saamtrek
dus werk hulle in antagonistiese pare
Om die arm te buig, trek die biseps saam
en die triseps ontspan
Om die arm te strek, trek die triseps saam en die biseps ontspan
Die bene dien as hefbome en die gewrig as die draaipunt
Artritis is ’n pynlike ontsteking van die gewrigte
waarin die kraakbeen wegslyt
Osteoporose laat die bene kalsium verloor en bros word
Dit kan voorkom word deur ’n dieet met genoeg kalsium en vitamien D, en deur oefening

questions.q: Synthesis
questions.qAf: Sintese
points: Relevance (1): all the information is about joints, movement and bone disorders; nothing irrelevant
Logical sequence (1): joint structure, then movement, then disorders
Comprehensive (1): at least 4/6 for the joint, 5/7 for movement and 2/4 for the disorders
pointsAf: Relevansie (1): al die inligting gaan oor gewrigte, beweging en beenafwykings; niks irrelevant nie
Logiese volgorde (1): gewrigstruktuur, dan beweging, dan afwykings
Omvattend (1): ten minste 4/6 vir die gewrig, 5/7 vir beweging en 2/4 vir die afwykings
